parsed.title: Inconsistent guard behavior
parsed.detail: The 'Turn contract' section states: 'Any blank required input was re-asked once; if still blank the skill emits `→ Next: execute-phase requires manual input — cannot proceed` and stops.' However, the 'Needs-input guard' section (line 68) defines the required input `<NN-slug>` and says: 'If blank or missing: re-ask once... If still blank, emit `→ Next: execute-phase requires manual input — cannot proceed` and stop.' This creates a conflict in the 'Turn contract' checklist which implies the guard is a single check, whereas the guard section defines a specific multi-turn retry logic for a specific parameter that isn't explicitly listed as a 'turn contract' item.
